    const du = depthTexU.sample(uv().add(vec2(0, px))).r;
    const dd = depthTexU.sample(uv().add(vec2(0, px.negate()))).r;
    const edge = clamp(abs(dl.sub(dr)).add(abs(du.sub(dd))).mul(6.0), 0.0, 1.0);
    const keyWarm = vec3(...new Color('#ffc890').toArray());
    plateMat.colorNode = c;
    plateMat.emissiveNode = keyWarm.mul(edge).mul(0.9);
  }
  plateMat.opacityNode = plateOpacity;

  const plate = new Mesh(plateGeo, plateMat);
  plate.position.set(0.35, 0.15, 0);
  group.add(plate);
  disposables.push(plateGeo, plateMat);

  ctx.textureLoader.loadTexture(config.imageUrl).then((tex) => {
    colorTexRef = tex;
    colorTexU.value = tex;
    plateMat.needsUpdate = true;
  });
  ctx.textureLoader.loadTexture(config.depthMapUrl).then((tex) => {
    depthTexRef = tex;
    depthTexU.value = tex;
    plateMat.needsUpdate = true;
  });

  // ---------- bottomScrim: gradient stops #0b0b1000 @0.45 -> #0b0b10eb @1.0 (color.gradient) ----------
  const scrimGeo = new PlaneGeometry(PLATE_W, PLATE_H);
  const scrimMat = new MeshBasicNodeMaterial();
  scrimMat.transparent = true;
  scrimMat.depthWrite = false;
  {
    const t = oneMinus(uv().y); // 0 top -> 1 bottom
    const a = smoothstep(0.45, 1.0, t).mul(0.92); // eb ≈ 0.92
    scrimMat.colorNode = vec3(...new Color(C_BG).toArray());
    scrimMat.opacityNode = a.mul(plateOpacity);
  }
  const scrim = new Mesh(scrimGeo, scrimMat);
  scrim.position.set(plate.position.x, plate.position.y, 0.22);
  group.add(scrim);
  disposables.push(scrimGeo, scrimMat);

  // ---------- captionBlock: kicker / headline / accent bar / body / caption ----------
  const items = config.textContent ?? config.intent?.visualSpec?.textContent ?? [];
  const byRole = (role, fallback) =>
    items.find((i) => i.role === role)?.text ?? fallback;

  const caption = new Group();
  const PAD = 0.5, BASE = 0.25;
  const left = plate.position.x - PLATE_W / 2 + PAD;
  const bottom = plate.position.y - PLATE_H / 2 + PAD;

  const kickerText = ctx.fontAtlas.createText(byRole('kicker', 'NOVA ATELIER / GENEVA'), {
    fontSize: 9, color: C_PAPER, align: 'left', letterSpacingPx: 1.1
  });
  kickerText.position.set(0, BASE * 4.4, 0);
  caption.add(kickerText);

  const headlineText = ctx.fontAtlas.createText(byRole('headline', 'Time, Machined.'), {
    fontSize: 34, color: C_PAPER, align: 'left'
  });
  headlineText.position.set(0, BASE * 3.1, 0);
  caption.add(headlineText);

  // accentBar: 0.75w x 0.02h emissive hairline (color.accent)
  const barGeo = new PlaneGeometry(0.75, 0.02);
  const barMat = new MeshBasicNodeMaterial();
  barMat.colorNode = vec3(...new Color(C_ACCENT).toArray()).mul(1.8);
  const accentBar = new Mesh(barGeo, barMat);
  accentBar.position.set(0.375, BASE * 2.2, 0);
  caption.add(accentBar);
  disposables.push(barGeo, barMat);

  const bodyText = ctx.fontAtlas.createText(
    byRole('body', 'Every case begins as a single billet of 904L steel.'),
    { fontSize: 13, color: C_PAPER, align: 'left', maxWidthPx: 420 }
  );
  bodyText.position.set(0, BASE * 1.3, 0);
  caption.add(bodyText);

  const captionText = ctx.fontAtlas.createText(byRole('caption', 'CALIBRE NA-01 / 72 HOUR RESERVE'), {
    fontSize: 9, color: '#9aa2ad', align: 'left', letterSpacingPx: 1.1
  });
  captionText.position.set(0, 0, 0);
  caption.add(captionText);

  caption.position.set(left, bottom, 0.35);
  group.add(caption);

  // ---------- contactGlow: foreground accent depth plane ----------
  const glowGeo = new CircleGeometry(2.4, 48);
  const glowMat = new MeshBasicNodeMaterial();
  glowMat.transparent = true;
  glowMat.depthWrite = false;
  {
    const r = uv().sub(vec2(0.5, 0.5)).length().mul(2.0);
    glowMat.colorNode = vec3(...new Color(C_SURFACE).toArray()).mul(1.4);
    glowMat.opacityNode = smoothstep(1.0, 0.0, r).mul(0.35);
  }
  const glow = new Mesh(glowGeo, glowMat);
  glow.position.set(0.35, -1.35, -1.2);
  glow.rotation.x = 0;
  group.add(glow);
  disposables.push(glowGeo, glowMat);

  // ---------- entranceMotion ----------
  const tl = gsap.timeline();
  tl.to(plateOpacity, { value: 1, duration: 0.5, ease: 'power2.out' }, 0);
  caption.position.y = bottom - 0.4;
  const capMats = [];
  caption.traverse((o) => { if (o.material) capMats.push(o.material); });
  capMats.forEach((m) => { m.transparent = true; m.opacity = 0; });
  tl.to(caption.position, { y: bottom, duration: 0.7, ease: 'power3.out' }, 0.12);
  tl.to(capMats, { opacity: 1, duration: 0.5, ease: 'power2.out' }, 0.12);
  // weighted settle on plate scale, then ONE slow idle breathing <=1.5%
  tl.fromTo(plate.scale, { x: 1.04, y: 1.04 }, { x: 1, y: 1, duration: 0.9, ease: 'power4.out' }, 0);
  timelines.push(tl);
  const idle = gsap.to(plate.scale, {
    x: 1.012, y: 1.012, duration: 4.2, yoyo: true, repeat: -1, ease: 'sine.inOut', delay: 1.2
  });
  timelines.push(idle);

  // ---------- primitives: apply EVERY config.cinematicPrimitives entry ----------
  for (const prim of config.cinematicPrimitives ?? []) {
    const fn = ctx.primitives[prim.name];
    if (fn) primHandles.push(fn(plate, prim.params));
  }

  // ---------- handlers + cleanup ----------
  group.userData.handlers = {};
  group.userData.cleanup = () => {
    timelines.forEach((t) => t.kill());
    primHandles.forEach((h) => h?.cleanup?.());
    disposables.forEach((r) => r.dispose?.());
    if (colorTexRef) colorTexRef.dispose?.();
    if (depthTexRef) depthTexRef.dispose?.();
    caption.traverse((o) => {
      o.geometry?.dispose?.();
      o.material?.dispose?.();
    });
  };

  return group;
}
